concept.subject: A great orb web beaded with dew, seen head on against a soft dusk of mauve and silver mist, with no spider anywhere: dozens of spokes run out from a bright hub through a dense spiral, and beyond the spiral single frame threads cross the sky to the walls.
concept.composition: The hub sits just left of the middle at a little under half the height. The spiral fills a near circle around it from a fifth to four fifths of the width, its top passing beside the cannon and its bottom running off the lower edge. Outside it, frame threads run from the top edge down to the sides: on the right from about four fifths of the width to the right wall at two fifths of the height, with a frame corner at seven eighths of the width and three fifths of the height and the frame running down from it; on the left from a quarter of the width down to a corner by the left wall a little over half way down, and on to a lower corner. The upper corners are open misty sky, the lower corners plain dark mist.
concept.layout: Round pegs only, 173: the stage's spiderweb, traced on the picture's own web. Twelve spokes run out from a peg at the hub, and six turns of the spiral are rings of dew around it: the four inner ones strung straight from spoke to spoke with a drop at every spoke (and one between on the third and fourth), the two outer ones beaded thickly, 34 px apart, where the picture's spiral ends. Those two outer turns are the slides: the channel between them opens beside the cannon on both sides, and a plain shot to the side drops into it and rattles down the web's flank, lighting up to two dozen drops. Outside the spiral, peg lines follow the frame threads and the spokes that run on to them. The cannon's clearance opens the top of the web, and the dew on the web's upper quarter cannot be orange (30 pegs: the top of the two outer turns, the top quarter of the third and fourth turns and the second turn's top drop), so the orange pegs gather in the middle and lower web.

features: Spiderweb layout with many round pegs (spec 8): 123 pegs scaled to 173

difficulty.note: Middle of the stage: the channel between the two outer turns gives a ride from the cannon on either side and the dense web lights many drops per shot, but the 30 drops of the upper web cannot be orange, so the orange pegs sit in the middle and lower web behind two to four turns.

background.prompt: A photo of a great orb web beaded with dew, seen head on against a softly blurred background of mauve, plum and silver mist, with no spider. The hub is a small bright knot just left of the center at about half the height; dozens of straight spokes run out from it through a dense spiral of closely spaced turns that fills a near circle around the hub, from about a fifth to four fifths of the width, its top running off the top edge and its bottom off the bottom edge. Beyond the spiral, single frame threads run from the top edge down and out to the sides: on the right from about four fifths of the width at the top to the right wall at about two fifths of the height, with a frame corner at about seven eighths of the width and three fifths of the height and the frame running down from it; on the left from about a quarter of the width at the top down to a corner near the left wall a little over half way down, and on to a lower corner. The mist is lightest on the left and darkest at the lower right; the upper corners are open misty sky, the lower corners plain dark mist.
